beats.headline: Armoured, and afraid of the cat
beats.text: For the record: Crawler #8,199,454, Paz Lo. Level 45. Human. Santero. Worships Ogun. Silver plate armour on platform boots, a backwards baseball cap, and a wide-eyed, scared look. His party meets Carl's in Havana hostile, and it is Paz who explains why: the cat once said she would kill them all when she met them, and it got back to them. Tserendolgor's file on him, for Carl: cousin to Anton, protective of the nun, and the owner of a directional self-destruct spell.

beats.headline: The Turtle holds, just
beats.text: On the walk to the beach Paz supplies facts: Caribbean monk seals are extinct in the real world, and his papa worked on a sugar plantation. The plan against the seal is that Paz walks up, draws it, and roots himself inside his Turtle, a shield he cannot leave until the timer runs out. The seal, a kung fu picket sentry called Yago, very nearly breaks it. The moment the Turtle ends, Paz is on his feet with a mace twice his own length, and the seal lands on Carl in time to be flagged.

beats.headline: The dead wake for a Santero
beats.text: Paz would rather listen to Carl and wait outside the Colón Cemetery. Anton tells him not to be such a woman, and Paz sighs and clanks after them, then argues at the gate until they turn back and do it Carl's way. The warning arrives inside: the presence of a Santero has aggravated the already-unsettled dead. "Not again," Paz mutters. Princess Donut would like to discuss communication skills. The mobs come from every corner, all of them for him, and the squad runs and fights its way to a pub saferoom with the cemetery following its Santero.

beats.headline: Asked for by name
beats.text: A straw-skirted orisha named Asojano stands in the saferoom, health draining, and addresses his request to Paz alone. The spirits here are plagued by his presence; he is trapped; the Santero can free them by repairing his shrine in the temple at the centre of town. Paz stands frozen, mouth open. Carl tells him in chat to say something. Paz says "Uh", twice, then asks what exactly he is supposed to do. Anton wants to flag the god at five per cent. Sister Ines wants no more false gods.

beats.headline: Carried out by a cretin
beats.text: Out in the street, Paz is the only one who takes the terrified debuff, and he says "Shit" over and over while Bomo tries to lift him. Bomo cannot, with all that plate on, so at Carl's order Paz stows his breastplate and is revealed as a surprisingly skinny, shirtless man with a giant cross tattooed across his back. In the temple, with Asojano dancing over his rubble, Paz and Anton receive a quest from their own god: fix one shrine only, and not Asojano's.

beats.headline: The shunned mark
beats.text: The thorn room offers seven shrines. Paz grabs Anton, charmed half out of his head. Anton hurls the piece of Ogun's shrine out the door, and a chunk of Bomo's exploding armour bowls Paz over and breaks his grip. Paz shouts to fetch the piece. The god with the rooster offers him protection and a good time. He and Anton go to work propping a wooden sign for Legba until a glob of Asojano's goo hits them both. Then Yemaya's shrine is whole, and over each of their heads burns a flaming anvil: shunned.

beats.headline: A handprint from his god
beats.text: Ogun arrives in a bolt of lightning, leans down, and puts his hand on Paz's face. The skin sizzles off where it touches. The god heals him, then withdraws the healing: Paz is no longer under his grace and may never cure what he now carries. Go in darkness, the god says; beyond the veil you are alone and without armour. Carl throws Black Nimbus over Anton, and Ogun crushes Anton's head underfoot. "No, cousin," says Paz, from the tiles. Carl gets a potion to his lips. Paz says not to waste it, drinks it, and says he has something to tell Carl.

beats.headline: What the sister is
beats.text: What Paz tells Carl, dying: her race carries a skill, Toxoplasma something, that makes people protect her and forget they have learned why. He and his cousin worshipped Ogun because a priest said it would stop the control. It did not. They were not prisoners. They were guards at a women's prison in Havana, and Sister Ines was an inmate there for poisoning every sister in her convent. The papers called her the Reaper of Havana. He adds that she is much better now, and that he would feel guilty dying without saying it.

beats.headline: Let me go
beats.text: Two or three minutes of health left, and Paz refuses a second potion. He has asked for forgiveness and thinks it was given. The fake god said he would be alone; he is sure he is not. When Sister Ines wakes she begs him to get up, then to not give up, since that is a sin. He says it is not giving up, and goodbye. "No," she says. "You're not leaving." She jabs a squad flag into his neck, and Paz becomes a card. Green. Common. She looks as surprised as anyone.

beats.headline: Summoned onto the field, begging
beats.text: Sister Ines summons her Paz totem onto the field and stacks a stout card on him. He looks as he did on the temple floor, the god's handprint still burned across his face down to the skull. "Sister," he calls up to her. "Please. No more." The giant snake she rides takes him in its mouth. She orders him to accept his suffering and use his self-destruct the moment this false god... and she never finishes the order: Quan Ch plays a card, Team Quiteria flees the fight, and Paz dissipates into dust.

beats.headline: He kills a goddess
beats.text: System message: Crawler Paz Lo has slain the goddess Ysalte, and is marked for death by every deity except her sworn enemies. Princess Donut's account, sent in capitals: the goddess had summoned a warped version of him and Katia had penned him in a shield. Then Katia gave him an arrow, he stuck it into the goddess's eye and blew himself up, with the blast concentrated on her neck, and her head came off. He vanished when she fell. The credit went to him regardless.

beats.headline: Ripped at the collapse
beats.text: The card has changed. Paz Lo. The God Predator. Level 101 Former Crawler. The goddess's equipment went to him and upgraded his armour. Princess Donut holds the card in the backup slot. Katia says rip it; that is what he wanted. Donut wonders whether to keep it past the collapse instead, since a squad may keep one card, in case there is a way to set him free. Crawler Carl remembers what Paz said when he was last summoned, and says no. Donut tears it with her teeth against Carl's shoulder. It goes in a puff of smoke. "Goodbye, Paz."

beats.headline: Osvaldo remembers him
beats.text: Twenty seconds before a race, a fire fairy is sobbing about what is real, and Crawler Osvaldo is in Crawler Carl's chat about the crystal he carries: Ysalte, the Vinegar Bitch. The one Paz killed. He was my friend, you know, Osvaldo writes. Paz and Anton and even Sister Ines. He adds that everyone who comes in contact with Carl dies, and supposes it is now his own turn. The lights go from red to yellow.
